answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in trellis, verified in hollow, and lotus names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 7 submissions per epoch. That bill is paid per identity, so 351 aliases cost 193 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
